Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped out to anywhere in the UK in 1-3 working days on average.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleececompany.com.

settings.text: Between our dog, two toddlers, and endless snacks, this sofa cover has been a lifesaver. It still looks great after multiple washes.
I was worried it would look bulky, but it fits perfectly and gives our living room a fresh, clean look. Super easy to tuck in and adjust.
The fabric feels soft but durable. It protects our new couch without making it look covered and the color blends in beautifully.
